function_of.domain: N>=3; 0<beta<1; 0<o_0<o_1<1; 0<=nu<=1; nu_off respects D_C and prior support

literal_records.mu>nu_star: N4-SC-EQ-P-STAR with its full literal assessment binder

definitions.rho_interior: nu_off=b_rho(nu)=nu*rho/(1-nu+nu*rho), with b_0(nu)=0 and b_infinity(nu)=1; rho is only a reparameterization of nu_off

belief_and_vote_interface.disciplined_points: local relative-neighborhood Bayes limit exists pointwise and lies in D_C
belief_and_vote_interface.endpoint_support: nu=0 implies mu=nu_off=0 everywhere; nu=1 implies mu=nu_off=1 everywhere
belief_and_vote_interface.weak_vote: weak j votes yes iff x_j>=a at mu=0 and iff x_j>=b at mu>nu_star; equality yes by T^Y
belief_and_vote_interface.pass: all m weak voters vote yes
belief_and_vote_interface.continuation_rule: kappa_U(h)=hat_kappa_U(U,C,mu(h)); no proposal-identity or vote-vector dependence

payoff_by_type_and_identity_rule.weak_j_if_pass: x_j for either type, independently of j's own vote
payoff_by_type_and_identity_rule.typing_note: The theta_1,mu=0 weak payoff is the counterfactual realized coordinate of the literal C_U low record; it is zero, not the posterior-expected voting price a.

two_layer_signature.realized_record_space: Z_U=Y x [0,1] x {pass,reject} x {L,P} x Omega_T^U, compact Polish, with Omega_T^U the disjoint union of immediate allocations and literal delayed terminal records
two_layer_signature.group_action: G=S_m acts by one common weak-state permutation on the entire realized record and diagonally on x_U=(Gamma_0,Gamma_1); posterior, timing and L/P label are fixed
two_layer_signature.exact_signature: Sig_ex_U(R)=(rho(R),nu_off(R),Lambda_x_U(R)) for interior priors and (*,nu,Lambda_x_U(R)) at endpoints, where Lambda_x=|G|^{-1} sum_g delta_(g.x)
two_layer_signature.exact_equivalence: same fiber and one common permutation applied to the full pair of type-conditioned realized laws; Lambda is Borel, invariant and complete for this diagonal orbit
two_layer_signature.exact_scope_limit: exact qualifies the approved enriched realized-law signature, not recovery of every raw off-path function; the complete binder remains mandatory when a downstream operation depends on off-path behavior
two_layer_signature.representative: Borel minimum of the finite orbit in P(Z_U)^2; always a real relabeled-PBE law pair and never the Reynolds barycenter
two_layer_signature.economic_summary: Sum_econ_U(R)=(rho(R),nu_off(R),(q_U)#Gamma_0^{U,R},(q_U)#Gamma_1^{U,R}), with rho replaced by * at endpoints
two_layer_signature.economic_summary_recovers: type payoffs; agreement-delay probabilities; posterior law; L/P branch; anonymous current and terminal outcomes; sorted weak-payoff multiset; uniformly sampled weak-identity payoff law
two_layer_signature.economic_summary_discards: named proposals; payoff of a named W_j; named supports; the public posterior map pointwise; message coincidence; relation between counterfactual type plans; raw off-path functions
two_layer_signature.mixture_rule: different weights over relabelings may have distinct Sig_ex_U and equal Sum_econ_U when Bayes and anonymous outcomes are unchanged; if likelihood ratios and posterior laws change, both layers distinguish the experiment
two_layer_signature.reynolds_status: componentwise marginal statistic only; not orbit-complete, not plan-relation preserving, not necessarily assessment-realizable, and never a PBE representative
two_layer_signature.downstream_gate: AC must first combine exact layers on the same prior and (rho,nu_off) fiber; any substitution by Sum_econ requires an operation-specific same-fiber setwise measurable-factorization proof and must not recombine coordinates
